comment: Secondary data source spreadsheet IDs, keyed by fiscal year. Two source types are distinguished: 'state_head_dashboard' (aggregated plan/ordered/received per person per month, used for FY2025-26 and FY2026-27) and 'register' (line-level secondary order rows, FY2021-22 through FY2024-25). IDs sourced from mgmt_sources.json secondary_order_booking.files_by_year. IMPORTANT: these are SECONDARY (distributor->retailer) figures and must never be summed with primary sale_line data.

2024-25.comment: Secondary order booking register FY2024-25. Tab: 'Data Sheet'. grain=line: individual customer-level rows.

2023-24.comment: FY2023-24 secondary register. Tab: 'Data Sheet'. grain=line: individual retailer transaction lines (confirmed from actual sheet — rows have RET# IDs and Cat.No, not pre-aggregated subtotals).

2022-23.comment: Secondary order booking register FY2022-23. Tab: 'Data Sheet'.

2021-22.comment: Secondary order booking register FY2021-22. Tab: 'Data Sheet'.
